g.text: Source-aligned RNA reconstruction: baseline programs and DFMO
68-hour mouse CD4 T-cell cultures | TMM + limma-voom | animal-blocked models
A: 3 WT animals, Th17p / Th17n / iTreg; B: 4 WT + 3 JMJD3 KO, Th17n / iTreg
Source-aligned reconstruction; exact author gene sets and supplementary-number concordance are unavailable.
Gene selection: BH q ≤ 0.05 and |log₂FC| ≥ log₂(1.5). Curves summarize selected-gene distributions, not independent replicates.
A differs from the published 3,414-gene PCA unless exact source selection is recovered. All tested genes and sensitivity partitions are retained.
